name: حساب نسبة الفوز لفريق رياضي (الحالة 3)
description: بناء برنامج يستقبل من المستخدم عدد المباريات التي فاز بها الفريق وعدد المباريات التي تعادل بها في بطولة مكونة من 12 مباراة ويحسب نسبة الفوز للفريق، مع احتساب التعادلات كنصف فوز. يجب أن يطلب البرنامج من المستخدم كل من المدخلين حتى يدخل المستخدم قيمة صالحة.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Ta'yeen al-qiyam al-ibtidaiyya lil-mutaghayyirat allati nahtajuha li-hadha al-barnamaj
total_games = 12
#Khatwa 2: Qira'at 'adad al-mubariyat allati faza biha al-fariq fi al-botola
text = input("Adkhil 'adad al-mubariyat allati faza biha al-fariq fi al-botola: ")
wins = int(text)      
#Khatwa 3: Tasdiiq madkhal al-mustakhdim li-'adad al-alfawaaz, is'al 'an madkhal sahiih ma tantahi al-mudkhalat al-ghayr sahiha; 'ikhraj idha lam yakun
while wins < 0 or wins > total_games :
    text = input("Adkhil 'adad al-mubariyat allati faza biha al-fariq fi al-botola: ")
    wins = int(text)
#Khatwa 4: Qira'at 'adad al-mubariyat allati ta'aadal laha al-fariq fi al-botola
text = input("Adkhil 'adad al-mubariyat al-muta'adila: ")
ties = int(text)
#Khatwa 5: Tasdiiq madkhal al-mustakhdim li-'adad al-ta'adulat, is'al 'an madkhal sahiih ma tantahi al-mudkhalat al-ghayr sahiha; 'ikhraj idha lam yakun
while ties < 0 or total_games < (ties + wins) :
    text = input("Adkhil 'adad al-mubariyat al-muta'adila: ")
    ties = int(text)
#Khatwa 6: Ahsib wa atba' nisbat al-mubariyat al-mafuuza li al-fariq, ma'a ihsaab al-ta'adulat ka nisf fawz
ratio = ( wins + ties // 2) / total_games
print("Nisbat al-fawz:", ratio)

نحتاج إلى التحقق من صحة العدد الذي أدخله المستخدم وطلب إدخال صالح طالما أدخل المستخدم قيمة غير صالحة. لذلك نحتاج إلى استخدام بنية حلقة. بما أننا لا نعرف مسبقاً عدد مرات تكرار الحلقة، نستخدم حلقة while. شرط حلقة while يختبر ما إذا كان يجب تكرار جسم الحلقة، لذا يجب أن يختبر ما إذا كانت القيمة التي أدخلها المستخدم غير صالحة.

الإدخال غير الصالح هو عندما يكون خارج النطاق المسموح، أي عندما يكون العدد الذي يدخله المستخدم سالباً أو أكبر من إجمالي عدد المباريات في البطولة.

يتم تكرار جسم حلقة while طالما أدخل المستخدم عدداً صحيحاً سالباً (أقل من صفر) أو أكبر من إجمالي عدد المباريات في البطولة. تنتهي الحلقة عندما تصبح قيمة شرط الحلقة False، أي عندما يدخل المستخدم عدداً غير سالب وأقل من أو يساوي إجمالي عدد المباريات في البطولة.

لاحظ أن عامل or المنطقي يكون True إذا كان أحد المعاملين أو كلاهما True.

untr_comments.content:
We need to validate the number that the user has entered and ask for a valid input as long as the user enters an invalid number. Therefore, we need to use a loop structure. Since we don't know ahead of time how many times the loop will be repeated, we need to use a while loop. The condition in the while loop tests whether the body of the loop should be repeated, so it should test whether the number that the user entered is an invalid number.

The input is an invalid number if it is outside the valid range, that is when the number that the user enters is negative or greater than the total number of games in the tournament.

The body of the while loop is repeated as long as the user enters an integer that is negative (less than zero) or greater than the total number of games in the tournament. The loop terminates when the loop condition evaluates to False, that is when the user enters a non-negative number that is less than or equal to the total number of games in the tournament.

Note that the logical or operator is True if one or the other or both operands are True.

We need to calculate the winning percentage by taking into account both ties and wins. Ties are counted as half wins. Therefore, we need to divide the sum of the number of games won and ties halved by the total number of games played. We store the result of the division into variable ratio.

Notice that we need to perform a floor division to obtain the value of ties halved (by using // operator). On the other hand, when we divide the sum of wins and ties halved by total games we need to perform a real division (by using / operator).
Notice that ties // 2 results in an int because // operator truncates the fractional part of the result, if there is any.

untr_name: Calculating the Winning Percentage of a Sports Team (Case 3)
untr_description: Construct a program that receives from the user the number of games that a sports team won and tied in a tournament of 12 games and calculates the winning percentage of the sports team, counting ties as half wins. The program must ask the user for each of the two inputs until the user enters a valid number.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Assign initial values to the variables which we need for this program
total_games = 12
#Step 2: Read the number of games that the sports team won in the tournament
text = input("Enter the number of games that the sports team won in the tournament: ")
wins = int(text)      
#Step 3: Validate the user input for the number of wins, ask for a valid input as long as the user enters an invalid number; otherwise stop
while wins < 0 or wins > total_games :
    text = input("Enter the number of games that the sports team won in the tournament: ")
    wins = int(text)
#Step 4: Read the number of games that the sports team tied in the tournament
text = input("Enter the number of games tied: ")
ties = int(text)
#Step 5: Validate the user input for the number of ties, ask for a valid input as long as the user enters an invalid number; otherwise stop
while ties < 0 or total_games < (ties + wins) :
    text = input("Enter the number of games tied: ")
    ties = int(text)
#Step 6: Calculate and print the percentage of games won by a team, counting ties as half wins
ratio = ( wins + ties // 2) / total_games
print("Winning percentage:", ratio)
